name: TralingLine
summary: TralingLine is a trailing stop utility EA that dynamically adjusts stop-loss levels by following a trend line drawn on the chart. It does not open its own positions but instead manages existing positions by moving their stop-loss to track a user-defined or algorithmically placed trend line, locking in profits as the market moves favorably.
summary_zh: TralingLine是一个追踪止损工具型EA，通过跟踪图表上绘制的趋势线来动态调整持仓的止损价位。它不自主开仓，而是管理已有持仓，随着市场有利移动将止损沿趋势线推移以锁定利润。
strategy_analysis: TralingLine的核心策略概念是基于趋势线的动态追踪止损管理，而非自主交易策略。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不自行开仓，而是依赖于用户手动或其它EA建立的持仓。出场条件由趋势线位置决定——当价格回撤突破趋势线时，止损被触发从而平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有订单的止损价位。资金管理方面，该工具通过趋势线追踪来保护已有利润，本质上是一种动态风险控制机制，随着趋势发展逐步锁定浮盈。其优势在于将技术分析中的趋势线直观地与止损管理结合，使交易者可以按照自己对趋势的判断来设定止损跟踪逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of TralingLine is dynamic trailing stop management based on a trend line, rather than an autonomous trading strategy. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open positions on its own; it relies on existing positions created manually or by other EAs. Exit conditions are determined by the trend line position — when price retraces beyond the trend line, the stop-loss is triggered to close the position. For position sizing, this EA does not calculate lot sizes as it only manages stop-loss levels of existing orders. Regarding money management, the tool protects unrealized profits by trailing along the trend line, essentially acting as a dynamic risk control mechanism that progressively locks in gains as the trend develops. Its strength lies in bridging technical analysis trend lines with stop-loss management, allowing traders to align stop tracking with their own trend interpretation.

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪止损调整步长（点数）
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop adjustment step in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定管理的订单魔术号，0表示管理所有订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: LineName
parameters.description: 趋势线对象名称，EA将跟踪此线的价格
parameters.description_en: Trend line object name for price tracking

parameters.name: ApplyToAll
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有持仓或仅当前品种持仓
parameters.description_en: Apply to all positions or current symbol only

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 趋势线所在的时间周期

pros: 将趋势线分析与止损管理直观结合，交易者可根据自身趋势判断灵活设置止损跟踪路径
不自行开仓，仅管理已有持仓，风险可控且不会产生意外仓位
提供魔术号过滤功能，可选择性管理特定EA的订单，避免冲突
pros_en: Intuitively combines trend line analysis with stop-loss management, allowing traders to set trailing stop paths based on their own trend judgment
Does not open positions independently, only manages existing ones, keeping risk controlled without unexpected positions
Provides magic number filtering to selectively manage orders from specific EAs, avoiding conflicts
cons: 完全依赖用户绘制趋势线，若未正确放置趋势线则EA无法有效工作
缺少对趋势线有效性的自动验证，用户可能误删或误移动趋势线导致止损管理失效
无滑点和点差过滤机制，在剧烈行情中止损调整可能不及时
cons_en: Completely depends on user-drawn trend lines; if the trend line is not properly placed, the EA cannot function effectively
Lacks automatic validation of trend line integrity; users may accidentally delete or move the trend line, causing stop management to fail
No slippage or spread filtering mechanism; stop-loss adjustments may lag during volatile market conditions
improvements: 增加趋势线有效性自动检测和报警功能，当趋势线被删除或移动时通知用户
添加自动趋势线绘制功能，基于分形或高低点算法自动生成追踪趋势线
improvements_en: Add automatic trend line validity detection and alerting; notify the user when the trend line is deleted or moved
Add automatic trend line drawing functionality, generating trailing trend lines algorithmically based on fractals or swing highs/lows

risk_points: 趋势线被误删或误移动时止损管理可能失效，存在持仓风险敞口
无新K线检查机制，高频调整可能在服务器负载较大时产生问题
risk_points_en: Stop-loss management may fail if the trend line is accidentally deleted or moved, leaving positions with unprotected risk exposure
No new bar check mechanism; high-frequency adjustments may cause issues under heavy server load
